description: This file contains shell script functions for configuring and managing an IPIP tunnel protocol, including setup, teardown, and configuration initialization.

methods.name: proto_ipip_setup
methods.description: Sets up an IPIP tunnel with provided configuration parameters, resolving peer address, validating interface, and sending configuration update.

methods.name: proto_ipip_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder function for tearing down IPIP tunnel, currently does nothing.

methods.name: proto_ipip_init_config
methods.description: Initializes protocol configuration options for IPIP, defining parameters like MTU, TTL, zone, address, and others.
